content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I need to display three different setpoints in a message window and adjust their values using the [product_name] operator device, all within the same screen. I am aware that if I display just one parameter in the message window, I can increase or decrease its value using function keys (F1 to F4) with some programming in [product_name] programming software. Alternatively, I could enter the set parameters mode and modify the values one at a time. My goal is to change multiple values directly from the message window. Is it possible to accomplish this? If so, how can this be done? Best regards.
I have a suggestion to offer as a reference.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is aiming to improve the workflow when using the [product_name] operator device by allowing direct and simultaneous display and adjustment of several setpoints within a single message window. Currently, only one parameter can be modified at a time, or users must navigate to a separate settings menu, which is less efficient and more involved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like to quickly view and modify several setpoints directly within the main message interface of the [product_name] operator device, without needing to switch screens or follow additional steps.
